# simplemdm_assignmentgroup_profile_binding (Resource)

Binds an existing SimpleMDM profile (or custom declaration) to an existing assignment group. Useful for managing memberships of UI-owned assignment groups (including dynamic groups) without taking ownership of the assignment group itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "simplemdm_assignmentgroup_profile_binding" "example" {
  assignment_group_id = "123456"
  profile_id          = simplemdm_customprofile.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assignment_group_id` (String) Identifier of the assignment group that should receive the profile.
- `profile_id` (String) Identifier of the profile (or custom declaration) to bind. SimpleMDM's `/api/v1/profiles` endpoint enumerates both profiles and custom declarations, so a custom declaration ID works here too.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form `"<assignment_group_id>:<profile_id>"`.

## Import

```sh
terraform import simplemdm_assignmentgroup_profile_binding.example <assignment_group_id>:<profile_id>
```
